  1. History of smartphones

    • texting.
    • phone calls.

  2. Reasons why I don't own a smartphone.

    • It's bad for your health.
      • Posture
      • Eyesight
      • Sleep
      • EMF?
    • Digital content
      • Nonsence content wastes your time.
      • Internalize things unconsciously introjection

      • computer literacy
      • learned helplessness

  3. It feels weird to not have a smartphone.
